title: Nigeria NHIA Accredited Health Maintenance Organisations Snapshot
description: A dated organisation-level snapshot of Health Maintenance Organisations listed by the National Health Insurance Authority as accredited. It is not a complete live health-insurance licensing or registration register.

source.title: Health Maintenance Organisations (HMOs)
source.format: HTML table embedded in NHIA WordPress page
source.extraction_method: HTML table cell extraction from the NHIA HMO page or its WordPress page JSON; dynamic page wrappers are ignored and the extracted table hash is verified.
source.personal_fields_present: The HMO table includes email and telephone columns; those contact fields are omitted from public records and reconciliation artifacts.
source.category_semantics: Rows are listed under the NHIA page heading for accredited Health Maintenance Organizations.
source.status_semantics: The source page heading identifies all listed rows as accredited; no row-level expiry or revocation status is published in the table.
source.terms: No machine-readable copyright or reuse terms were found on the public source page; preserve NHIA attribution and review source terms before downstream redistribution.

supporting_sources.title: Private Health Plan
supporting_sources.use: Confirms NHIA describes private health plans as provided by Health Maintenance Organisations and links users to accredited HMOs.

supporting_sources.title: State Social Health Insurance Agencies (SSHIAs)
supporting_sources.use: Identified as a separate category from HMOs; not combined into this dataset because it lists state schemes and includes named directors and personal contact fields.

rejected_dataset_names.ng-health-insurance-organisations: Rejected because the verified row-level source covers accredited HMOs only and does not cover all NHIA-recognised health-insurance organisation categories.
rejected_dataset_names.ng-nhia-accredited-organisations: Rejected because it is broader than the HMO-only source table.
rejected_dataset_names.ng-accredited-health-maintenance-organis: Rejected because it omits the NHIA authority prefix that distinguishes the source and regulatory context.

source_limitations: The source is an NHIA HMO page snapshot, not a complete live health-insurance licensing or registration register.
The source table lists accredited Health Maintenance Organizations but does not publish row-level expiry dates, revocation status or historical accreditation periods.
The source table includes contact fields; websites, addresses, emails and telephone numbers are omitted from the public contract in this foundation phase.
No websites or logos are included in the public dataset.
State Social Health Insurance Agencies are a separate NHIA-listed category and are not included in this HMO roster.
The dataset does not establish that every Nigerian health-insurance organisation is licensed, registered or currently operational.
No enrollee, patient, practitioner, staff, claims, policy, payment, banking or identity-document information is published.
licensing: NHIA source material retains its own rights. SoftData claims only its independent normalization, schema, identifiers, reconciliation and metadata.

generation.input: NHIA HMO HTML table projection or committed reconciliation replay
